scope: Routing PR review hardening; synthetic measurements, not production throughput
notes: Aggregate values are means of per-run means; per-case runs are retained.
Two full 35-case hot runs per boundary; two extra paired 100-rule parent and 10000-rule child runs.
Later generic-primary-key compatibility commits do not change matching or publication paths.
Footprint baseline drains store retirement before measurement; retained ETS, not VM RSS.
Cold synthetic timings include cleanup/barrier, task creation, tree build, encoding, registration and Cachex put, but exclude parsing and DB.
Cold memory_bytes capture caller allocations only and must not be interpreted as worker or total publication allocation.
Fallback has one smoke/performance run per corrected boundary, not an outage/concurrency throughput measurement.
